item.title: POPIA Compliance for South African SMEs: Checklist & Steps 2026
item.description:
Navigating POPIA Compliance for South African SMEs in 2026

South Africa’s Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) protects personal data, forcing SMEs to handle customer, employee, and supplier info responsibly. Non-compliance risks fines up to R10 million or 10 years’ imprisonment—but getting it right builds trust and avoids breaches. SME South Africa

item.title: Zero Trust Architecture
item.description:
How Zero Trust Changes Perimeter-Based Security

Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) is an approach to designing security controls, not a single product. NIST SP 800-207 describes an architecture that does not grant implicit trust based on a user’s or device’s network location or ownership. Access to an enterprise resource is authenticated and authorized before a session is established.
